about: Gemstok HQ renewals — dates only, never keys. Edit in HQ → Renewals (or here; HQ re-reads it).

renewals.name: Sign in with Apple — client secret
renewals.what: Apple sign-in on the websites and Android stops working for everyone (iPhone apps keep working).
renewals.how_to: gemstok-backend/docs/runbooks/apple-client-secret.md → paste into Supabase → Gemstok → Authentication → Providers → Apple → Secret Key

renewals.name: Apple Developer Program membership
renewals.what: Apps leave the App Store, TestFlight and Sign in with Apple stop.
renewals.how_to: developer.apple.com → Account → Membership (turn on auto-renew)

renewals.name: Cloudflare API token (Gemstok HQ)
renewals.what: HQ → Websites and the R2 pie stop loading.
renewals.how_to: dash.cloudflare.com → My Profile → API Tokens → Gemstok HQ → Roll, then HQ → Settings → Replace
renewals.notes: Only if you chose "1 year" when making it. No expiry → set no date.

renewals.name: AdMob sign-in in HQ (Google, Testing mode)
renewals.what: HQ → Money: AdMob turns red.
renewals.how_to: HQ → Settings → Other services → AdMob → Sign in with Google
renewals.notes: Only while the consent screen is in Testing. "In production" → it doesn't expire; remove this.

renewals.name: Domain — gemstok.com
renewals.what: Main site, account.gemstok.com, systems.gemstok.com, admin@/legal@ email and Sign in with Apple pages — EVERYTHING Gemstok.
renewals.how_to: Your registrar (Porkbun or GoDaddy) → Domains → gemstok.com → check the real expiry date, auto-renew ON, card still valid.
renewals.notes: Registered 2025-01-02 (Obsidian note says "02/feb" — check). Last renewal assumed 2026-01-02. Date is a guess (1-year terms) — read the real expiry at the registrar and fix it here.
